steps.name: source_admission
steps.rule: Accept manual or owner-approved intake only

steps.name: stable_key
steps.rule: Normalise source and title into opportunity_key

steps.name: required_fields
steps.rule: Require intake_id, source, title, fit_score and publishable

steps.name: duplicate_guard
steps.rule: Search Opportunities by opportunity_key before any write

steps.name: route_decision
steps.rule: Select accepted, duplicate, invalid or owner_review

steps.name: bounded_writes
steps.rule: Write only to the tables allowed by the route matrix

steps.name: terminal_status
steps.rule: Save processed, duplicate, invalid or needs_review
